RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from 0 to 100

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your qualifications justify asking how the decision was reached, but the announcement may omit her relevant experience. Leadership and consultation skills might also have carried substantial weight.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, and feedback on your assessment. Check whether your degree or licence was mandatory, and whether recruitment rules were followed.

Raise sex discrimination if specific evidence emerges—such as sex-related comments, inconsistent standards, or an explicit preference—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for a reply may not suspend them.
